items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I'd have to associate it with Ross Columbo and Bing Crosby. They both sounded alike.

ctx.x: No, no scales. I wouldn't even know what the scales were, it was the song that I had to learn. And if they were playing and I didn't know, I'd go downstairs by my self and see if I could get it. And I'd get it most of it. Most of the time if we played it a couple of times, I had it, whatever it was. And he never complained so evidently I must have been playing it right.
Did you ever copy things off of records?
No, I didn't have a record machine. I just never had no record machine for a long, --- It came from the radio, everything I learned, radio.
